Predictions & assumptions

Route is a user-supplied planned route based on one recorded passage. Recorded trip geometry and typical cruise speed inform this estimate. Canal and inlet slow-zone bounds remain approximate. Slow zones, bridge inventory, clearance and local station assignments are incomplete. NOAA predictions are queried directly for nearby stations and interpolated between six-minute values; nearest station assignments are provisional. Tide heights are not water depths. Conditions can differ from predictions.
